description: Check which dates are free. With destinationId alone it returns the site-wide availability calendar. With accommodationTypeId it returns per-date availability and the party-adjusted nightly price for that one unit. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and the window is limited to 120 days. Returns availability and nightly prices only; the full stay total comes from get_quote.

accommodationTypeId.description: Optional — narrows to one unit type.

numDogs.description: Dogs in the party. Affects availability at dog-friendly sites; not a separate charge here.

name: check_availability
title: Check HolidayFox availability
